messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
river_cruise | Singapore River Cruise | 28 | 40 | 09:00-22:30 | -
night_safari | Night Safari | 56 | 180 | 19:15-24:00 | -
river_wonders | River Wonders | 43 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
buddha_tooth | Buddha Tooth Relic Temple | 0 | 45 | 07:00-17:00 | -
ocbc_skyway | OCBC Skyway | 14 | 30 | 09:00-21:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
acm | Asian Civilisations Museum | 25 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
gardens_domes | Flower Dome and Cloud Forest | 46 | 120 | 09:00-21:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
river_cruise: night_safari 44, river_wonders 45, buddha_tooth 13, ocbc_skyway 15, national_museum 13, acm 12, gardens_domes 15
night_safari: river_cruise 44, river_wonders 11, buddha_tooth 46, ocbc_skyway 48, national_museum 43, acm 45, gardens_domes 48
river_wonders: river_cruise 45, night_safari 11, buddha_tooth 46, ocbc_skyway 48, national_museum 43, acm 46, gardens_domes 48
buddha_tooth: river_cruise 13, night_safari 46, river_wonders 46, ocbc_skyway 16, national_museum 15, acm 13, gardens_domes 16
ocbc_skyway: river_cruise 15, night_safari 48, river_wonders 48, buddha_tooth 16, national_museum 16, acm 14, gardens_domes 11
national_museum: river_cruise 13, night_safari 43, river_wonders 43, buddha_tooth 15, ocbc_skyway 16, acm 13, gardens_domes 16
acm: river_cruise 12, night_safari 45, river_wonders 46, buddha_tooth 13, ocbc_skyway 14, national_museum 13, gardens_domes 14
gardens_domes: river_cruise 15, night_safari 48, river_wonders 48, buddha_tooth 16, ocbc_skyway 11, national_museum 16, acm 14

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Planning a trip from 11:00 to 17:55 with a S$127 budget. I'm hoping to hit Singapore River Cruise, River Wonders, Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, and Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. If there's time, I'd also love to see Night Safari, OCBC Skyway, National Museum of Singapore, and Asian Civilisations Museum. Just a heads up, I need to be at River Wonders no earlier than 14:35 and finished there by 17:40.

response:
```python
import json
import z3

def solve():
    s = z3.Solver()

    # Places definitions
    places = {
        "river_cruise": {"cost": 28, "dur": 40, "open": 540, "close": 1350},
        "night_safari": {"cost": 56, "dur": 180, "open": 1155, "close": 1440},
        "river_wonders": {"cost": 43, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
        "buddha_tooth": {"cost": 0, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1020},
        "ocbc_skyway": {"cost": 14, "dur": 30, "open": 540, "close": 1260},
        "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
        "acm": {"cost": 25, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
        "gardens_domes": {"cost": 46, "dur": 120, "open": 540, "close": 1260},
    }

    travel_times = {
        ("river_cruise", "night_safari"): 44, ("river_cruise", "river_wonders"): 45, ("river_cruise", "buddha_tooth"): 13, ("river_cruise", "ocbc_skyway"): 15, ("river_cruise", "national_museum"): 13, ("river_cruise", "acm"): 12, ("river_cruise", "gardens_domes"): 15,
        ("night_safari", "river_cruise"): 44, ("night_safari", "river_wonders"): 11, ("night_safari", "buddha_tooth"): 46, ("night_safari", "ocbc_skyway"): 48, ("night_safari", "national_museum"): 43, ("night_safari", "acm"): 45, ("night_safari", "gardens_domes"): 48,
        ("river_wonders", "river_cruise"): 45, ("river_wonders", "night_safari"): 11, ("river_wonders", "buddha_tooth"): 46, ("river_wonders", "ocbc_skyway"): 48, ("river_wonders", "national_museum"): 43, ("river_wonders", "acm"): 46, ("river_wonders", "gardens_domes"): 48,
        ("buddha_tooth", "river_cruise"): 13, ("buddha_tooth", "night_safari"): 46, ("buddha_tooth", "river_wonders"): 46, ("buddha_tooth", "ocbc_skyway"): 16, ("buddha_tooth", "national_museum"): 15, ("buddha_tooth", "acm"): 13, ("buddha_tooth", "gardens_domes"): 16,
        ("ocbc_skyway", "river_cruise"): 15, ("ocbc_skyway", "night_safari"): 48, ("ocbc_skyway", "river_wonders"): 48, ("ocbc_skyway", "buddha_tooth"): 16, ("ocbc_skyway", "national_museum"): 16, ("ocbc_skyway", "acm"): 14, ("ocbc_skyway", "gardens_domes"): 11,
        ("national_museum", "river_cruise"): 13, ("national_museum", "night_safari"): 43, ("national_museum", "river_wonders"): 43, ("national_museum", "buddha_tooth"): 15, ("national_museum", "ocbc_skyway"): 16, ("national_museum", "acm"): 13, ("national_museum", "gardens_domes"): 16,
        ("acm", "river_cruise"): z3.IntVal(12), ("acm", "night_safari"): 45, ("acm", "river_wonders"): 46, ("acm", "buddha_tooth"): 13, ("acm", "ocbc_skyway"): 14, ("acm", "national_museum"): 13, ("acm", "gardens_domes"): 14,
        ("gardens_domes", "river_cruise"): 15, ("gardens_domes", "night_safari"): 48, ("gardens_domes", "river_wonders"): 48, ("gardens_domes", "buddha_tooth"): 16, ("gardens_domes", "ocbc_skyway"): 11, ("gardens_domes", "national_museum"): 16, ("gardens_domes", "acm"): 14
    }

    must_visit = ["river_cruise", "river_wonders", "buddha_tooth", "gardens_domes"]
    optional_visit = ["night_safari", "ocbc_skyway", "national_museum", "acm"]

    trip_start = 660  # 11:00
    trip_end = 1075   # 17:55
    budget = 127

    # Variables for each place
    visits = {}
    for pid in places:
        visits[pid] = {
            "is_visited": z3.Bool(f"visit_{pid}"),
            "start": z3.Int(f"start_{pid}"),
            "end": z3.Int(f"end_{pid}")
        }

    # Must-visit constraints
    for pid in must_visit:
        s.add(visits[pid]["is_visited"] == True)

    # Budget constraint
    total_cost = z3.Sum([
        z3.If(visits[pid]["is_visited"], places[pid]["cost"], 0)
        for pid in places
    ])
    s.add(total_cost <= budget)

    # Time window and duration constraints
    for pid, data in places.items():
        v = visits[pid]
        dur = data["dur"]
        open_t = data["open"]
        close_t = data["close"]

        s.add(z3.Implies(v["is_visited"], z3.And(
            v["start"] >= trip_start,
            v["end"] <= trip_end,
            v["start"] >= open_t,
            v["end"] <= close_t,
            v["end"] == v["start"] + dur
        )))

    # Special constraints for River Wonders
    s.add(z3.Implies(visits["river_wonders"]["is_visited"], z3.And(
        visits["river_wonders"]["start"] >= 875,  # 14:35
        visits["river_wonders"]["end"] <= 1060    # 17:40
    )))

    # Non-overlapping and travel time constraints
    pids = list(places.keys())
    for i in range(len(pids)):
        for j in range(len(pids)):
            if i == j:
                continue
            id1, id2 = pids[i], pids[j]
            v1, v2 = visits[id1], visits[id2]
            tt = travel_times.get((id1, id2), 0)

            # If both are visited, v2 must start after v1 ends + travel time, OR v1 must start after v2 ends + travel time
            s.add(z3.Implies(
                z3.And(v1["is_visited"], v2["is_visited"]),
                z3.Or(
                    v2["start"] >= v1["end"] + tt,
                    v1["start"] >= v2["end"] + tt
                )
            ))

    if s.check() == z3.sat:
        m = s.model()
        result = []
        for pid in places:
            if z3.is_true(m.evaluate(visits[pid]["is_visited"])):
                start_val = m.evaluate(visits[pid]["start"]).as_long()
                end_val = m.evaluate(visits[pid]["end"]).as_long()
                result.append({
                    "location_id": pid,
                    "start": start_val,
                    "end": end_val
                })
        # Sort by start time
        result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
        print(json.dumps(result))
    else:
        print("UNSAT")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```
